questions.title: Does Vercel strip a client-sent x-vercel-isr header before _render or _isr runs?
questions.evidence: At 71ae513, entrypoint.ts:24-25 replaces the request path with the x_astro_path query parameter whenever the request carries x-vercel-isr: 1, even without a valid x-astro-middleware-secret. Before this change only a valid secret enabled the override (commit 335a204). Whether a client can set x-vercel-isr on a request that reaches the function directly depends on Vercel's platform behavior, which this repository does not show.
questions.why_it_matters: If the platform strips or overwrites that header on external requests, the branch is not reachable by a caller and no finding applies. If it does not, any direct caller of _render or _isr can choose the rendered route, reopening the path override that 335a204 closed; that would be a must-fix security finding.
questions.answer: Vercel platform owners or a maintainer with Vercel access can confirm whether client-supplied x-vercel-isr is stripped or overwritten on external requests to the functions. A measurement also settles it: on a deployment, send a request with x-vercel-isr: 1 and ?x_astro_path= set to a route the edge middleware blocks, and check whether that route is served.

observations.fact: The change adds no test for the new x-vercel-isr branch: the PR states no test cases were added, and the existing path-override tests send only the untrusted query parameter or header, never x-vercel-isr.

requirements.evidence: Title: 'fix(vercel): Fix ISR path rewrite to prevent 404'. The ISR 404 outcome depends on Vercel's ISR invocation, which the offline clone cannot exercise; the pull request's manual e2e deployment evidence is cited but not reproduced.

'Fix a bug which prevented pages from being served by ISR by the vercel adapter.' The fix is implemented in entrypoint.ts:24-25; whether ISR pages are served correctly on Vercel is a platform outcome not reviewable offline.

'we need to change the request path when serving an ISR path': entrypoint.ts:24-25 rewrites the path for ISR requests, but the trigger is a client-sendable header (see the question on packages/integrations/vercel/src/serverless/entrypoint.ts/isr-header-path-override).
